entry.title: Detection of Targeted Executive Asset Compromise
entry.summary: An adversary targets high-value executive assets using whaling and MFA bypass to access sensitive corporate roadmaps and financial data via stealthy living-off-the-land techniques.

entry.title: Administrative AI Configuration File Tampering
entry.summary: An adversary has modified system-wide AI configuration files or hooks on a Linux endpoint to bypass security constraints or establish persistence outside the managed reconciliation workflow.

entry.title: Automated EDR Response Action Reconciliation
entry.summary: An adversary has compromised a management principal or repurposed an Elastic workflow to perform mass remote execution across the Linux fleet, masquerading as a legitimate configuration reconciliation loop.

entry.title: Star Blizzard RedFlick VHDX and SSH-based Malware Delivery
entry.summary: An adversary has gained initial access via phishing and is using the RedFlick technique to deliver a backdoor through VHDX-mounted scripts, SSH-based MSI downloads, and CPL-driven scheduled tasks.

entry.title: Kubernetes Operator RBAC Abuse and Secret Theft
entry.summary: A vulnerable or outdated Kubernetes operator is running with excessive ClusterRole permissions, allowing an attacker to exfiltrate cluster-wide secrets or establish unauthorized AI agent bridges to external endpoints.

entry.title: Storm-3068 Build Pipeline Execution and Tunneling
entry.summary: An adversary has modified build pipelines to execute malicious code on agents, deploying RMM tools and establishing tunnels to exfiltrate Kubernetes credentials.

entry.title: Cloud Identity Takeover and DevOps Enumeration
entry.summary: An adversary hijacked a cloud identity using self-service password reset to perform automated discovery across Azure DevOps repositories and harvest Kubernetes configuration files.

entry.title: ChatGPT Custom GPT ClickFix Lure and MSI Installer
entry.summary: An attacker is redirecting users from ChatGPT Custom GPTs to a ClickFix site, triggering PowerShell commands that download and install a malicious MSI from a decimal-encoded IP address.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced Collaboration and Browser Attacks
entry.summary: An adversary has bypassed traditional email defenses using AI-enhanced social engineering to trick a user into granting OAuth permissions or installing a malicious browser extension, leading to session hijacking and persistent access.

entry.title: AI-Enhanced OSINT and Identity Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary is using AI-automated OSINT to identify vulnerable web applications and craft high-fidelity phishing lures, leading to server exploitation and account takeover for fraud.

entry.title: Exploitation of AI-Generated Vibe-Coded Applications
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting vulnerabilities in AI-generated applications—such as missing input validation or hardcoded secrets—to gain initial access, brute-force credentials, or execute code from user-writable directories.

entry.title: North Korean Exploitation and Destructive Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting internet-facing vulnerabilities to gain initial access before encrypting user files to generate revenue or sabotage operations.

entry.title: AI Coding Agent Sandbox Activity
entry.summary: An unauthorized user is running an AI coding harness to modify production codebases, using automated testing to validate the changes and communicating with external LLM APIs.

entry.title: Akira Ransomware Exfiltration and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is exfiltrating bulk data via SFTP using FileZilla and executing Akira ransomware, evidenced by massive outbound network transfers and the destruction of Volume Shadow Copies.

entry.title: Bumblebee Persistence and AD Credential Harvesting
entry.summary: An adversary has established internal persistence through unauthorized remote access tools like RustDesk and is performing Active Directory credential harvesting by dumping the NTDS database and LSASS memory.

entry.title: Bumblebee Delivery and C2 Establishment
entry.summary: An intruder has lured an administrator to a look-alike download page via SEO poisoning, leading to a trojanized installer that side-loads Bumblebee via consent.exe and establishes AdaptixC2.

entry.title: Executive Identity Harvesting and Dark Web Abuse
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed infostealer malware on a high-profile device to harvest PII and SSNs, which are subsequently traded on dark web marketplaces and used for account impersonation.

entry.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Edge Appliance Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting a chain of SSRF and command injection vulnerabilities on a SonicWall SMA1000 appliance to achieve remote code execution, indicated by rare HTTP management traffic followed by shell spawns from web processes.

entry.title: GitLab Critical API Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unauthenticated path traversal in the GitLab repository commits API to read server configuration or using insecure deserialization in Duo Chat to extract sensitive credentials.

entry.title: AI-Driven Persistence and Automated Data Theft
entry.summary: An adversary is using compromised AI runtimes to maintain persistence and automate the exfiltration of sensitive data to AI skill repositories.

entry.title: EDR Impairment and Ransomware Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is stealing credentials from browser stores and attempting to disable security controls using vulnerable drivers before launching a high-volume ransomware or exfiltration attack.

entry.title: AI Agent and Social Engineering Initial Access
entry.summary: An adversary has gained initial access by using AI-generated phishing lures, malicious AI skills, or ClickFix social engineering where users paste malicious terminal commands.

entry.title: Cloud Runtime, Lateral Movement, and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary has compromised a cloud workload using valid credentials and is moving across network segments before encrypting data and suppressing alerts via webhooks.

entry.title: Identity Access and Exposure Investigation
entry.summary: An adversary has harvested credentials through a phishing portal and is now using them to access vulnerable assets while attempting to evade multi-factor authentication.

entry.title: Remote access and persistence via scheduled tasks
entry.summary: An attacker has gained access via an external remote service and established persistence using a scheduled task that executes a remote administration tool or a malicious script.

entry.title: Legacy System Access and Segmentation Bypass
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unpatchable public-facing services or unauthorized VPN bridges to discover and laterally move toward isolated legacy OT assets.

entry.title: Citrix NetScaler Zero-Day Exposure
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting zero-day remote code execution vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler appliances, characterized by anomalous HTTP requests to management interfaces followed by the execution of unauthorized shell commands.

entry.title: Windows Zero-Day Privilege Escalation and Ransomware
entry.summary: Adversaries are exploiting unpatched Windows ALPC or Update Stack vulnerabilities to escalate to SYSTEM integrity and deploy ransomware, leaving traces of rare process elevations and specific link-resolution artifacts.

entry.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQLi Exploitation
entry.summary: An unauthenticated attacker has exploited CVE-2026-76461 by sending a crafted email to a Cisco Secure Email Gateway, resulting in root-level command execution from a database process.

entry.title: Zimbra BEC: Manufactured Reality and Manipulation
entry.summary: An attacker has compromised a Zimbra server and is manipulating organizational trust by configuring unauthorized mail forwarding and initiating outbound connections to meeting platforms to facilitate social engineering.

entry.title: Exploitation of Zimbra Mail Services
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in Zimbra services to execute discovery commands via spawned shells or drop JSP-based webshells for persistence.

entry.title: Contextual Investigation of Phased PowerShell Intrusions
entry.summary: An adversary has gained initial access via remote services, executed PowerShell for post-exploitation, and established persistence through scheduled tasks to maintain a C2 connection.

entry.title: Obfuscated Phishing and Exfiltration in Node Environments
entry.summary: An adversary has deployed an obfuscated phishing kit on an asset with developer tools like npm, using encoded HTTP query parameters to exfiltrate stolen credentials and session cookies to rare or known-malicious domains.

entry.title: Obfuscated JavaScript and Local Collection
entry.summary: An intruder is using obfuscated JavaScript within npm install scripts or malicious browser extensions to collect credentials and cookies from the local endpoint while evading static analysis.

entry.title: NeedyMantis Modular Sideloading and WebSocket C2
entry.summary: An adversary has established long-term access by sideloading modular components into legitimate processes like Poedit or Vim, using encrypted archives staged in unusual directories to bypass detection.

entry.title: AI-Integrated Malware Execution and Orchestration
entry.summary: Adversaries use AI frameworks or local runtimes for autonomous malware orchestration, detectable through cognitive artifacts like framework-specific imports, natural-language evasion strings, and outbound provider API traffic.

entry.title: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass and Exposure
entry.summary: An unauthenticated attacker has exploited CVE-2026-19490 on an internet-facing NetScaler appliance to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized remote access.

entry.title: F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth RCE Exploitation
entry.summary: An unauthenticated attacker is exploiting a heap-based buffer overflow in F5 BIG-IP APM by sending crafted traffic to virtual servers configured with OAuth profiles to achieve code execution.

entry.title: Internal Coercion and Editor Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary is using rogue DHCPv6 services to perform DNS takeover for Kerberos relaying, or has established persistence via unauthorized Kate editor plugins on compromised hosts.

entry.title: Exploitation of Web-Facing GitLab and Langflow
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting GitLab unauthenticated file reads or Langflow authenticated RCE to access repository secrets or execute code on the server host, starting from public-facing assets.

entry.title: Exvicy ClickFix Social Engineering and PowerShell Execution
entry.summary: An adversary is using compromised WordPress sites to deliver Exvicy ClickFix lures that trick users into executing a PowerShell downloader via social engineering keyboard shortcuts.

entry.title: M365 Session Hijacking and Malware Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has bypassed MFA by stealing M365 session tokens via DocuSign-themed phishing, enabling them to execute malicious droppers and deploy ransomware across the fleet.

entry.title: SSO Takeover and Data Impact
entry.summary: An adversary has bypassed SSO protections using stolen credentials and is now performing bulk data exfiltration or deploying ransomware across the environment.

entry.title: Infostealer execution and browser credential harvesting
entry.summary: An adversary has successfully phished a user and executed an infostealer, which is now harvesting browser credentials and cookies from local SQLite databases for exfiltration.

entry.title: ClickFix Browser Injection and Extension Persistence
entry.summary: An intruder has used a social engineering lure to trick a user into manually injecting a JavaScript loader or installing a malicious Tampermonkey script that facilitates persistent cryptocurrency theft via the Google Visualization API.

entry.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday September 2026 Exposure
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting September 2026 zero-day or critical remote code execution vulnerabilities, such as those in DNS Server or the Windows Update Stack, to establish initial access or escalate privileges on unpatched systems.

entry.title: Autonomous AI Command-and-Control and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is using autonomous AI-driven malware to orchestrate command-and-control decisions via LLM API calls, followed by high-volume data encryption for impact.

entry.title: Socially Engineered Endpoint Infection and Evasion
entry.summary: An attacker uses social engineering lures such as consultancy offers to trick users into running trojanised software that installs an EDR killer and steals credentials.

entry.title: AI-Accelerated Post-Exploitation and Extortion
entry.summary: An intruder is using AI-driven automation to conduct rapid internal reconnaissance, steal AI service tokens, and triage sensitive files for extortion at machine speed.

entry.title: Machine-Speed Perimeter and Identity Ingress
entry.summary: An automated attacker is exploiting unpatched perimeter services or using AI-refined phishing to compromise identities, resulting in successful sign-ins from rare geolocations that correlate with known gateway vulnerabilities.
